title: 7. Ozma of Oz to the Rescue

paragraphs.en: Dorothy received bread and water from Nanda for her supper. She slept on a hard stone couch with a single pillow and a silken coverlet. In the morning, she peered out of her tower window to check for escape routes.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西从娜达那里得到了面包和水作为晚餐。她睡在一座坚硬的石床上，只有一只枕头和一条丝质被单。清晨，她透过塔楼的窗户向外张望，寻找可能的逃生路线。

paragraphs.en: The room wasn't very high up by modern standards but was far enough above the trees and farmhouses to offer a good view of the surrounding countryside.
paragraphs.zh: 这个房间虽然不算太高，但已经高出树木和农舍不少，能够俯瞰四周的乡村景色。

paragraphs.en: To the east, she saw a forest with sands beyond it and an ocean further still. A dark speck on the shore might have been her chicken coop. To the north, there was a deep valley between two rocky mountains, with another mountain blocking its end.
paragraphs.zh: 向东望去，她看到一片森林，森林外是沙地，更远处是一片海洋。岸边的一个黑点可能是她的鸡舍。向北看，则是两座岩石山之间的一条深谷，另一座山挡住了山谷的尽头。

paragraphs.en: Westward, the fertile Land of Ev abruptly ended near the palace, revealing miles of sandy desert stretching to the horizon.
paragraphs.zh: 西行之处，埃夫富饶的国土突然在宫殿附近戛然而止，展露出一片无尽的沙漠，一直延伸到天边。

paragraphs.en: This desert, she thought, separated her from Oz. She remembered that no one had ever crossed it except herself—once by cyclone and once by silver shoes. Now, without these aids, her situation seemed dire.
paragraphs.zh: 这片沙漠，她心想，将她与奥兹国隔开。她记得除了自己之外，无人曾穿越过这里——一次是借助龙卷风，另一次则是银鞋的帮助。而现在没有了这些助力，她的处境似乎十分危急。

paragraphs.en: The princess demanded Dorothy exchange her head for another, which might not fit.
paragraphs.zh: 公主要求多萝西换一个头颅，这个新头可能大小不合适。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy's old friends in Oz offered no hope of rescue. From her narrow window, she watched the desert, seeing nothing stirring at first. Then, something appeared—a cloud, a silver spot, and finally, a mass of rainbow colors moving swiftly toward her.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西在奥兹国的老朋友们似乎无法提供救援的希望。她从狭窄的窗户外望出去，起初什么也没有看到。然后，突然出现了一些东西——先是朵云彩，接着是一个银色的斑点，最后是一片五彩斑斓的颜色迅速向她移动过来。

paragraphs.en: What could it be? The vision drew near enough for Dorothy to make out what it was: a broad green carpet unrolling across the desert, followed by a magnificent procession that amazed her as she watched.
paragraphs.zh: 那会是什么呢？这景象渐渐靠近，多萝西终于看清了——是一块宽广的绿色地毯在沙漠中展开，后面跟着一支让她惊叹不已的壮观队伍。

paragraphs.en: Ozma of Oz arrived in a magnificent golden chariot drawn by a great Lion and an immense Tiger. The girl, standing upright within, wore silver gauze robes and a jeweled diadem. She held satin ribbons for her team and an ivory wand with "O" and "Z" at the top, made of diamonds.
paragraphs.zh: 奥芝国公主奥兹玛驾临，乘坐一辆华丽的金色战车，由一头雄伟的狮子和一只巨大的老虎牵引。少女端坐车内，身着银色薄纱长袍，戴着镶嵌宝石的王冠。她手持丝带，为车队打理，并握有一根象牙法杖，顶端刻有“O”和“Z”，均由钻石制成。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy recognized Ozma from Tiktok's recent mention. Behind the chariot came the Scarecrow riding a wooden Saw-Horse, which moved gracefully like any horse. Nick Chopper, the Tin Woodman, marched on foot at the head of twenty-seven soldiers in colorful uniforms.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西认出了奥兹玛，因为提基托最近提起过她。在战车之后，稻草人骑在一匹木制的锯齿马背上，这匹马动作优雅，就像真正的马一样。铁皮人尼克·切弗则身穿色彩鲜艳的军装，在二十几名士兵前面步行前进。

paragraphs.en: The green carpet rolled up to keep their feet safe from the deadly desert sands. Dorothy knew it was magic and felt hope as she saw her friends approaching. She believed they would be reliable allies.
paragraphs.zh: 绿色的地毯卷起，保护着他们的双脚免受致命沙漠沙子的侵害。多萝西知道那是魔法，看到朋友们渐渐走近，她感到一阵希望。她相信他们一定会是可靠的盟友。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy shouted from above, "Here I am! Here's Dorothy!" The Scarecrow, tipping his head back, nearly fell off his Saw-Horse as he tried to see who was calling.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西从上面喊道：“我在这儿！多萝西就在下面！”稻草人向后仰起头，几乎从锯马上下了去，试图看清是谁在呼唤。

paragraphs.en: "Dorothy Gale, of course," she clarified.
paragraphs.zh: “当然，是多萝西·盖尔。”她解释道。

paragraphs.en: "Hello, Dorothy!" the Scarecrow called down. "What are you doing up there?"
paragraphs.zh: “多萝西！”稻草人喊道，“你在那里做什么？”

paragraphs.en: "Nothing," she replied, "because there's nothing to do. Save me, my friend—save me!"
paragraphs.zh: 她回答说：“没什么可做的，因为确实没有什么事情。救救我，我的朋友——救救我！”

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow assured her, "You seem safe now." But Dorothy pleaded, "I'm a prisoner, locked in so I can't get out."
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人向她保证：“你现在看起来是安全的。”但多萝西恳求道：“我是个囚犯，被锁住无法出去。”

paragraphs.en: Ozma, listening from the chariot, asked, "Why did Princess Langwidere lock you up?"
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛坐在战车上听到了这个问题，问道：“兰瓜黛尔公主为什么要把你关起来？”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy explained, "She wouldn't let me give my head for her collection. I refused to take an old, cast-off head instead."
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西解释说：“她不允许我为了她的收藏牺牲自己的头。我坚决不肯用一个旧的、不再使用的头来代替。”

paragraphs.en: Ozma immediately agreed, "I will see the Princess and release you." Dorothy thanked Ozma profusely.
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛当即应允：“我去见公主，救你出来。”多萝西向奥兹玛连声道谢。

paragraphs.en: Ozma then drove her chariot to the third door of the wing, where the Tin Woodman knocked boldly. The maid opened it, allowing Ozma to step inside with her ivory wand.
paragraphs.zh: 然后，奥兹玛驱车来到了翼楼的第三扇门前，铁皮人敲门时显得十分大胆。女仆开了门，让奥兹玛手持象牙魔杖走进了屋内。

paragraphs.en: Ozma of Oz entered the drawing-room with her company, excluding the Lion and Tiger. The twenty-seven soldiers made so much noise that Nanda, a little maid, ran screaming to Princess Langwidere. Angered by this intrusion, the princess rushed into the room.
paragraphs.zh: 奥芝国公主奥兹玛带着她的随从进入了客厅，狮子和老虎没有跟进来。那二十七名士兵闹得沸反盈天，一个小丫鬟奈达吓得尖叫着跑向兰格维德公主。面对这突如其来的打扰，公主怒不可遏，冲进了房间。

paragraphs.en: "Who dares enter my palace uninvited?" she demanded, her No. 17 head flashing with fury.
paragraphs.zh: “谁敢未经邀请擅自闯入我的宫殿？”她怒气冲冲地问道，第17号头颅闪烁着愤怒的光芒。

paragraphs.en: "Leave immediately or I'll bind you and throw you in my dungeons!"
paragraphs.zh: “立刻离开，否则我把你绑起来扔进我的地牢里！”

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow whispered, "She seems nervous." The Tin Woodman agreed, adding nothing more.
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人低声说道：“她看起来有点紧张。”锡人木偶赞同地点了点头，没有再说什么。

paragraphs.en: Ozma remained calm. "Please sit down," she said quietly. "I've traveled far to see you; listen to what I have to say."
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛保持冷静。“请坐下来，”她平静地说，“我特地赶来见你；请听我说。”

paragraphs.en: "Must!" screamed the Princess. "To ME!"
paragraphs.zh: 公主喊道：“必须！给我做！”

paragraphs.en: "To be sure," Ozma replied. "As Ruler of Oz, I could destroy your kingdom if I wished, but I came to free Queen Ev and her children from the Nome King's captivity."
paragraphs.zh: “当然，”奥兹玛回答道，“作为奥兹国的统治者，我本可以轻易摧毁你们的王国，但我是来解救埃夫女王和她的孩子们，使他们脱离诺姆王的囚禁的。”

paragraphs.en: Hearing this, Langwidere grew quiet.
paragraphs.zh: 听到这话，兰戈黛尔默不作声了。

paragraphs.en: "I wish you could free my aunt and her ten royal children," she said eagerly. "They could rule Ev themselves, saving me time for admiring my heads."
paragraphs.zh: 她急切地说：“我希望你能把我的姑妈和她的十位皇家子女解放出来，让他们自己统治埃夫兰，这样我可以有更多时间欣赏我的头饰。”

paragraphs.en: "Let’s discuss freeing them soon," Ozma said. "First, release the girl in your tower."
paragraphs.zh: “我们尽快讨论一下如何解救他们吧,”奥兹玛说道。“首先，释放你塔中的那个女孩。”

paragraphs.en: Langwidere agreed readily. "I forgot about her yesterday." They went up to the tower room.
paragraphs.zh: 兰格韦德欣然同意。“我昨天差点把她忘了。”他们走上塔楼的房间。

paragraphs.en: Ozma's followers stayed behind in the drawing-room while they ascended.
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛的随从留在客厅里，而他们则上楼去了。

paragraphs.en: Ozma entered the room, leading Dorothy and followed by Princess Langwidere. The Scarecrow noticed a machine-like figure standing nearby. A harsh voice suddenly spoke from Tiktok's mouth: "Get off my foot, please.
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛走进房间，领着多萝西，后面跟着朗基努丝公主。稻草人注意到旁边站着一个机器般的人形物体。突然，铁皮人蒂托克的声音 harsh 地说道：“请从我的脚上挪开。”

paragraphs.en: You are scratching my polish."
paragraphs.zh: 你这是在刮我的漆。

paragraphs.en: "Oh, excuse me!" replied the Scarecrow, drawing back. "Are you alive?"
paragraphs.zh: “哦，对不起！”稻草人后退一步回答道，“你还活着吗？”

paragraphs.en: "No," said Tiktok. "I am only a machine. But I can think and speak when properly wound up.
paragraphs.zh: “不，”钛金属人说道，“我只是一台机器。但只要适当上紧发条，我也能思考和说话。”

paragraphs.en: Right now, my action is rundown, and Dorothy has the key to it."
paragraphs.zh: 目前我的行动有些混乱，而道丽特手中握有关键。

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow nodded. "Dorothy will soon be free, and then she'll attend to your works. It's unfortunate not to be alive, but you have no brains like me."
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人点了点头。“多萝西很快就会获救，然后她会处理你的事务。虽然不能活着真是太遗憾了，但你可没有我这样的智慧。”

paragraphs.en: Tiktok corrected him: "I do have brains, fitted with Smith & Tinker's Improved Combination Steel Brains. They make me think. What about you?"
paragraphs.zh: Tiktok纠正他说：“我确实有大脑，装的是史密斯与廷克改良组合钢制大脑。它们让我思考。你呢？”

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow admitted he didn't know his own brain type. "They were given by the Wizard of Oz and I never examined them before he put them in."
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人承认自己也不清楚这些脑子的类型。“它们是奥兹巫师给我的，以前我从未仔细检查过，在他放进去之前。”

paragraphs.en: Tiktok added: "I have no conscience, nor a heart like the Tin Woodman." The Tin Woodman chimed in, saying they were both alive, with active hearts and brains that didn't need winding.
paragraphs.zh: Tiktok脱口而出：“我没有良知，也没有锡人一样的心脏。”锡人附和道，说他们俩都是活生生的，拥有活跃的心脏和大脑，并不需要上发条。

paragraphs.en: Tiktok felt inferior but acknowledged his machine nature. He begged not to be taken apart by the Scarecrow, who promised he wouldn't tamper with Tiktok's interior out of respect for his usefulness.
paragraphs.zh: Ticktack 感到自己有些逊色，但还是承认了自己的机械本质。他央求稻草人不要拆解自己，稻草人承诺出于对 Ticktack 有用性的尊重，不会擅自改动他的内部构造。
